selection_rationale: An all-3g fleet so it can kite as one: 40 torpedoes to fire in coordinated saturation salvos, with 3 frigates adding 6 PD turrets against incoming rounds and coilguns to finish emptied or crippled enemy hulls. Every ship can match speed with the others, so the fleet can dictate range against slower capitals and burn away from enemy waves.
formation_rationale: The three cheap Ward frigates go 50 km forward as a picket line. They take the first exchange and give forward PD cover against incoming torpedoes. The five Dart corvettes, our main hitting power at 24 pts each, sit about 20 km back in a shallow arc that's offset up and down. That keeps every Dart within about 100 km of at least one Ward and of its neighboring Darts, so PD coverage overlaps. The spread also means no two hulls line up on the same bearing for an enemy spinal shot. The arc is wide enough that the Darts can swing out to the flanks once the screen has taken the first hits.
